layout.body:
Municipal Charter
Sign up for paperless billing statements today.
Safe, convenient, easy. Enroll in paperless billing to receive monthly savings account statements in an electronic PDF document. Access your Municipal Charter account through the mobile app and select account preferences in the upper right- hand corner to enroll.

questions.stem: What type of business issued the notice?
questions.analysis: What type of business issued the notice? 原文依据：monthly savings account statements 每月储蓄账户对账单 A：网络供应商 → 错误 B：电脑公司 → 错误 C：造纸公司 → 错误 D：银行 → 正确

questions.stem: How can customers enroll in paperless billing?

options.A: By visiting a Municipal Charter office
options.B: By accessing the Municipal Charter website
options.C: By using the Municipal Charter app
options.D: By calling a Municipal Charter customer service representative

questions.analysis: How can customers enroll in paperless billing? 原文依据：Access your Municipal Charter account through the mobile app and select account preferences… to enroll. 通过手机应用登录账户，选择账户偏好…… 即可注册。 A：前往办事处 → 错误 B：访问网站 → 错误 C：使用手机应用 → 正确 D：致电客服 → 错误
